IncidentEvents.message: We've successfully applied a routing change in a test environment to remove the affected network path, and confirmed it did not disrupt connectivity. Teams are now gaining access to the production environment to apply the same change. We're also working to resolve a sign-in issue that is limiting internal access to the cloud management console needed for mitigation. We'll provide our next update upon a significant development.

Engineering identified a network-routing issue involving a recently added proxy path. Traffic sent through this path is intermittently failing because the required network permissions were not in place before traffic was enabled. 

Teams are preparing to remove the affected path from service so traffic uses the existing healthy route. Access to the cloud management console is currently unavailable, and Salesforce is engaging the cloud provider to restore access and proceed with the mitigation.

Planned migration activity involving the affected instance remains paused as a precaution. We'll provide an update in 60 minutes or sooner if additional information becomes available.

Engineering has identified a likely network configuration issue involving a recently added traffic-routing path. Some requests using this path are timing out when connecting to supporting services. Teams are evaluating two mitigation options: removing the new routing path or completing the required network permissions so traffic can flow successfully.   

As a precaution, planned migration activity involving the affected instance has been paused while mitigation is in progress. We'll provide an update in 30 minutes or sooner if additional information becomes available.

We're investigating an issue affecting connectivity between some Salesforce environments and Long-Term File Storage. Customers may experience delays or intermittent failures when accessing files, and org migrations are being impacted. Our teams are actively investigating and working to restore normal connectivity. We'll provide an update in 30 minutes or sooner if additional information becomes available.
